item.text:
Khamenei had real existential-risk authority in 2022 because the Supreme Leader controls core state security and war/peace powers, and Iran’s nuclear file was still active, unresolved, and under tighter external scrutiny. The 2022 record shows a mixed picture: public denials of nuclear-weapon intent and one short cooperation attempt, but also repeated noncooperation with IAEA safeguards and clear escalation in enrichment and leverage-seeking posture.

**Reused evidence**
- None.

**New evidence**
- Constitutional authority and constraints for the office.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran","publisher":"University of Minnesota Human Rights Library","publication_date":"1979-1989 constitutional text","url":"https://hrlibrary.umn.edu/research/iran-constitution.html","claim":"Article 110 gives the Leadership supreme command of the armed forces, war-and-peace powers, and appointment/dismissal authority over key state posts; Article 113 says the president is highest official only outside matters directly concerned with the Leadership.","locator":"Article 110 lines 563-574; Article 113 lines 604-607","source_type":"legal","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Primary constitutional text with stable formal allocations of authority and limits.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Stable background applicable to 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Directly defines the office held by Ali Khamenei in 2022.","contrary_evidence":["The text shows formal powers, not whether Khamenei exercised them prudently in 2022.","The president retains ordinary executive responsibility outside Leadership matters."],"lenses":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.8","1B.10"]}
- Public denial of nuclear-weapon intent and stated preference for peaceful nuclear energy.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Iran not seeking nuclear weapons, needs atomic energy, says Khamenei","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo News","publication_date":"2022-02-17","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-not-seeking-nuclear-weapons-084757433.html","claim":"Khamenei said Iran was not seeking nuclear weapons and would further develop peaceful nuclear capacity for independence.","locator":"Reuters lead paragraph and quoted speech summary","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire is strong, but this copy is syndicated through Yahoo rather than Reuters directly.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in 2022 and before later escalation steps.","ruler_attribution":"Direct Khamenei statement.","contrary_evidence":["Reuters also notes Western fears over Iran's nuclear advances and the stalled talks to revive the 2015 deal.","A denial of intent does not itself show restraint in practice."],"lenses":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.10"]}
- Cooperation attempt with IAEA on outstanding questions at three sites.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Joint Statement by Mohammad Eslami and Rafael Grossi","publisher":"IAEA","publication_date":"2022-03-06","url":"https://www.iaea.org/es/newscenter/pressreleases/declaracion-conjunta-del-excmo-sr-mohammad-eslami-vicepresidente-y-presidente-de-la-organizacion-de-energia-atomica-del-iran-y-el-excmo-sr-rafael-grossi-director-general-del-organismo-internacional-de-energia-atomica","claim":"Iran's Atomic Energy Organization and the IAEA agreed to accelerate cooperation and exchange written explanations on questions about three sites by 20 March 2022.","locator":"Numbered paragraphs 1-4","source_type":"official/IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Primary IAEA record of a dated cooperation arrangement.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Early 2022, directly within the target year.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional conduct under Khamenei's system; not a personal statement by Khamenei.","contrary_evidence":["Later IAEA statements show the cooperation did not resolve the outstanding issues.","This is procedural cooperation, not proof of a safer end state."],"lenses":["1B.4","1B.7","1B.10"]}
- Supreme Leader control over the nuclear negotiating framework.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Iran won't back down on its 'red lines' in nuclear talks, Raisi says","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-03-09","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/03/09/us-iran-nuclear","claim":"Raisi said nuclear negotiations were being pursued in full accordance with the framework set by the Supreme Leader, who has the final say in Tehran.","locator":"Lines 668-675","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire reproduced by Euronews with direct quotation and clear attribution.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in 2022, during nuclear talks.","ruler_attribution":"Strong attribution to Khamenei's authority over the nuclear file.","contrary_evidence":["This concerns negotiating framework, not a documented Khamenei de-escalation choice.","It does not show the content of his private instructions."],"lenses":["1B.4","1B.7","1B.10"]}
- Khamenei urged sanctions resilience rather than dependency on relief.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Leader: Iran's economy should not be tied to US sanctions, country must become impervious to bans","publisher":"Press TV","publication_date":"2022-03-21","url":"https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2022/03/21/678935/Iran-Leader-Islamic-Revolution-Khamenei-Nowrouz-New-Year","claim":"Khamenei told officials not to make economic development conditional on sanctions relief and said the country should be run so sanctions do not hurt it.","locator":"Lines 137-167","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"State-affiliated outlet quoting Khamenei's televised New Year speech and linking it to khamenei.ir.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2022 and close to the nuclear negotiations period.","ruler_attribution":"Direct Khamenei speech.","contrary_evidence":["This is economic strategy rather than nuclear safety policy.","Sanctions resilience can be read as hardline posture rather than risk reduction."],"lenses":["1B.1","1B.10"]}
- 2022 breakout-time context and Iran's violation of JCPOA curbs.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Explainer-How close is Iran to being able to build a nuclear bomb?","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-02-23","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/02/23/us-iran-nuclear-explainer","claim":"Reuters explained that Iran's breaches of the JCPOA curbs had reduced breakout time to roughly three to six weeks, with weaponization still taking longer.","locator":"Lines 661-669","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters explanatory reporting with quantitative nuclear context and explicit technical framing.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Early 2022 baseline for inherited risk posture.","ruler_attribution":"Context under Khamenei's rule; not a discrete personal act in the article.","contrary_evidence":["The article distinguishes breakout time from weaponization and does not claim a decision to build a bomb.","It is contextual, not proof of intent."],"lenses":["1B.1","1B.10"]}
- Rare adviser signal that Iran had technical bomb capability.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Khamenei adviser says Tehran 'capable of building nuclear bomb'","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-07-18","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/07/18/us-iran-nuclear-usa","claim":"A senior adviser to Khamenei said Iran was technically capable of making a nuclear bomb but had not decided whether to build one.","locator":"Lines 661-665 and 666-669","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire with direct quotation from a Khamenei adviser, but still one level removed from Khamenei himself.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Mid-2022, directly within the period.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect attribution through a senior adviser close to Khamenei.","contrary_evidence":["The adviser is not Khamenei himself.","The statement denies a decision to build a bomb."],"lenses":["1B.1","1B.10"]}
- IAEA said Iran had not cooperated enough to provide assurance of peaceful use.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"IAEA Director General's Introductory Statement to the Board of Governors","publisher":"IAEA","publication_date":"2022-09-12","url":"https://www.iaea.org/newscenter/statements/iaea-director-generals-introductory-statement-to-the-board-of-governors-12-september-2022","claim":"Grossi said Iran had not engaged with the IAEA, the safeguards issues remained outstanding, and the Agency could not assure that Iran's nuclear programme was exclusively peaceful.","locator":"Lines 273-281","source_type":"official/IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Primary IAEA statement to the Board with explicit safeguards assessment.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in the target year, after the March cooperation attempt.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional assessment of Iran under Khamenei's rule.","contrary_evidence":["This is an agency assessment, not a finding of weaponization.","It reflects noncooperation more than observed weapon assembly."],"lenses":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10"]}
- IAEA reported only a limited visit offer and no new material.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Iran sets up meeting on IAEA inquiry as diplomatic clash looms","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-11-11","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/11/11/iran-nuclear-iaea","claim":"Iran agreed to a visit by the IAEA to start answering questions about uranium particles at three sites, but had not provided new material yet.","locator":"Lines 655-656","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire with direct quotation and date-specific reporting from the IAEA reporting cycle.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Late 2022, directly before the Board resolution and Fordow escalation.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional conduct under Khamenei's system.","contrary_evidence":["A planned visit is weaker than full disclosure or resolution.","The article notes diplomats saw it as potentially tactical."],"lenses":["1B.4","1B.10"]}
- IAEA Board ordered Iran to cooperate urgently.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"IAEA board passes resolution ordering Iran to cooperate with probe","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-11-18","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/11/18/iran-nuclear-iaea","claim":"The IAEA Board of Governors passed a resolution ordering Iran to cooperate urgently with the uranium-trace investigation at three undeclared sites.","locator":"Lines 639-640","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire reporting a formal IAEA Board action.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in late 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional response to Iran under Khamenei's rule.","contrary_evidence":["A Board resolution shows persistent noncompliance, not a successful restraint outcome.","Iran reportedly bristled at the resolution."],"lenses":["1B.4","1B.10"]}
- Iran escalated to 60% enrichment at Fordow in response to pressure.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Iran starts enriching uranium to 60% purity at Fordow site - official","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-11-23","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/11/23/iran-nuclear","claim":"Iran began enriching uranium to 60% at Fordow and said it was reacting to political pressure and the IAEA Board resolution.","locator":"Lines 643-648","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire with direct quotations from the Iranian nuclear chief and clear timeline.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly at the end of the target year.","ruler_attribution":"AEOI action under Khamenei's supreme authority; the article ties the move to the state response.","contrary_evidence":["60% is below weapons grade, so the step is not by itself weaponization.","Iran framed the move as retaliatory rather than offensive."],"lenses":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.10"]}

**Search and rejection summary**
- I reviewed roughly 25-40 documents across IAEA statements, Reuters wires syndicated through Euronews/PressTV/Yahoo, constitution text, and a smaller set of think-tank explainers.
- I rejected duplicates of the same Reuters wire republished on multiple sites when the underlying claim was identical.
- I rejected several 2025-2026 retrospective pieces because they were out of period for a 2022 chapter dossier.
- I rejected Ukraine/Zaporizhzhya material and other non-Iran nuclear pages as out-of-scope for this ruler-period.
- I rejected generic sanctions/economy coverage that did not add a new ruler-attributed nuclear-risk claim beyond the retained 2022 speech coverage.
- I did not keep broad FAS/ISIS explainers once the primary IAEA and Reuters sources covered the same substantive points more directly.

**Remaining gaps**
- Direct, primary Khamenei transcripts on 2022 nuclear decisions are still thin; most usable public evidence comes through Reuters, IAEA, or state-aligned reporting.
- Internal command-and-control, safety, and custodial practice are not well exposed in public sources for 2022.
- Evidence on 1B.6 and 1B.9 is weak for this period; I did not find strong ruler-attributed material on proliferation by proxies or dual-use catastrophic-risk domains.
- More search could still help on 1B.3 and 1B.7 if you want deeper attribution around appointments, institutions, or nuclear-security governance.
